fields.definition: Ca2+ in the sarcoplasm binds troponin, causing tropomyosin to slide away and expose myosin-binding sites on actin

support.quote: The first step in the process of contraction is for Ca ++ to bind to troponin so that tropomyosin can slide away from the binding sites on the actin strands.

fields.scientific_name: Calcium ions (Ca2+) in the sarcoplasm of the skeletal muscle fibre

support.quote: As long as Ca ++ ions remain in the sarcoplasm to bind to troponin, which keeps the actin-binding sites “unshielded,”
